name: dsh-dsml-guard
description: Keeps model output in the right block: leaked <thinking>/<analysis> text is moved into real reasoning blocks instead of showing as prose, DSML tool calls that leaked into the body are wrapped in a ```text fence and kept (no longer deleted, no tool is ever executed), and commands or patches the model merely narrated are fenced as code. Also resumes a turn when a 继续 genuinely helps (max-tokens, empty or closed streams, misclassified network blips) with a default cap of 3 consecutive failures reset by any normal reply; quota and context-window errors never resume, while AUTH and INVALID_REQUEST stay off by default but can be opted in. Overlap with DSH's own per-provider retry policy (EMPTY_RESPONSE/SERVER/TIMEOUT/TRANSPORT) is delegated to the host by default, and ticking such a code takes effect only when the host retry is provably not active this turn. Every switch has a settings page. / 把模型输出放回正确的区块：漏进正文的 thinking/analysis 段搬回真正的「思考」块、不再当正文显示；漏进正文的 DSML 工具调用包进代码围栏保留（不再整段删掉，也绝不真去执行）；模型只念出来没真执行的命令与补丁包成代码块。同时只在「发继续能真正解决」时补发（max-tokens、空响应/流中断、被误分类的网络抖动），默认连续 3 次失败后停发、正常回复清零；额度与上下文超限一律不续，鉴权失败与请求被拒默认不续但可勾选。与 DSH 自带「重试策略」重叠的四个错误码默认交给宿主，勾选后也要先确认宿主本轮没在重试才生效。所有开关都在客户端设置页。
author: Jessicaisleep
